units.source_text: 且说一条院的排场设备，由于公主尚在丧服之中，自然不同于一般。

en.t: As for the arrangements at Ichijo Palace, because the princess was still in mourning, they were naturally unlike the usual ones.

units.source_text: 这样的开端未免是不祥的。

en.t: Such a beginning could hardly help seeming ill omened.

units.source_text: 但在大家吃过素斋、人声静息的时候，夕雾走过来了。

en.t: But after everyone had eaten the vegetarian mourning meal and the voices had fallen quiet, Yugiri came over.

units.source_text: 他频频催促小少将君，要她引导与公主相会。

en.t: He repeatedly pressed Lady Koshosho to guide him to a meeting with the princess.

units.source_text: 小少将君说：“大将如果真有久长之志，务请过一两天再来。

en.t: Lady Koshosho said, "My lord, if your intentions are truly lasting, please come again after a day or two.

units.source_text: 公主回到旧邸，反而添了新愁，已像死人一般躺卧着了。

en.t: Since returning to her old residence, the princess has only gained new sorrow, and now lies there like someone dead.

units.source_text: 我们从旁劝慰，公主反而痛苦。

en.t: When we try to comfort her at her side, it only causes the princess more pain.

units.source_text: 常言道：‘凡事都为自己’，我们岂肯触犯公主！

en.t: As the saying goes, 'Everything is done for one's own sake'; how could we possibly risk offending the princess?

units.source_text: 所以此刻实在不便通报。”

en.t: So at this moment it is truly not convenient for us to announce you."

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“奇怪极了！

en.t: Yugiri said, "How very strange!

units.source_text: 这真是我所料想不到的啊！

en.t: This is something I never expected at all!

units.source_text: 公主的心竟同小孩一样莫名其妙。”

en.t: The princess's heart is as baffling as a child's."

units.source_text: 便向小少将君仔细分辩，说他这办法为公主、为自己都顾虑周至，决不会受世人非难。

en.t: He then explained himself carefully to Lady Koshosho, saying that his plan showed full consideration for both the princess and himself and would never draw public blame.

units.source_text: 小少将君答道：“使不得啊！

en.t: Lady Koshosho replied, "That must not be done!

units.source_text: 我们正在担心：这回不要再送走了这个人？

en.t: We are already anxious, wondering whether this time we may lose this person again.

units.source_text: 大家心慌意乱，手足无措。

en.t: Everyone is flustered, distraught, and at a complete loss.

units.source_text: 我的好大将！

en.t: My good lord!

units.source_text: 求求你，千万不要强词夺理，干这种不近人情的事啊！”

en.t: I beg you, please do not force your argument and do such an inhumane thing!"

units.source_text: 便向他合掌礼拜。

en.t: Then she pressed her palms together and bowed to him in supplication.

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“我从来不曾受过这种冷遇。

en.t: Yugiri said, "I have never before been treated so coldly.

units.source_text: 公主如此蔑视我，把我看作比谁都可厌可恶，教我好伤心啊！

en.t: The princess despises me so much and sees me as more hateful and detestable than anyone else; it wounds me deeply!

units.source_text: 究竟谁是谁非，我想叫人评评理看。”

en.t: I should like someone to judge, after all, which of us is right and which is wrong."

units.source_text: 他无可再说，恼羞成怒了。

en.t: With nothing more to say, he grew angry from shame and frustration.

units.source_text: 小少将君终于也觉得不好意思，微笑着答道：“大将说从来不曾受过这种冷遇，实因大将尚未深解男女之情之故。

en.t: Lady Koshosho at last felt embarrassed too, and replied with a smile, "My lord says he has never been treated so coldly only because he still does not deeply understand the feelings between men and women.

units.source_text: 道理究竟谁是谁非，让人评判吧。”

en.t: As for who is truly right or wrong in principle, let others judge."

units.source_text: 小少将君虽然固执，但如今已无法坚拒，只得跟着他进去。

en.t: Although Lady Koshosho had been stubborn, she could no longer firmly refuse him and had no choice but to go in with him.

units.source_text: 夕雾猜量公主所居之处，进入室内。

en.t: Yugiri guessed where the princess was staying and entered the room.

units.source_text: 公主非常懊恼，痛恨此人横蛮无礼，便不顾别人讥笑她孩子气，立刻在储藏室内铺一条茵褥，躲进里面，把门从内侧锁上，就在那里睡觉。

en.t: The princess was deeply distressed and bitterly hated this man's arrogant rudeness, so, not caring if others mocked her as childish, she immediately laid a mat in the storeroom, hid inside, locked the door from within, and slept there.

units.source_text: 但在这里毕竟能躲到几时呢？

en.t: But how long, after all, could she hide there?

units.source_text: 那些侍女都已丧心病狂，袒护对方了。

en.t: Those gentlewomen had all gone mad, it seemed, and were siding with the other party.

units.source_text: 她想想不胜痛恨。

en.t: The more she thought about it, the more unbearably hateful it seemed.

units.source_text: 夕雾深怪公主冷酷无情，他想：“你如此抗拒，我决不甘休。”

en.t: Yugiri deeply resented the princess's cold heartlessness and thought, "If you resist me like this, I will never give up."

units.source_text: 他满怀信心，独睡户外，左思右想，直到天明，自己觉得好像隔溪而宿的山鸟。

en.t: Full of confidence, he slept alone outside, thinking this way and that until dawn, feeling like a mountain bird sleeping apart across a stream.

units.source_text: 好容易天亮了。

en.t: At last day broke.

units.source_text: 夕雾心念只管如此坚持下去，势必变成仇视，还不如暂且出去吧。

en.t: Yugiri thought that if he kept pressing on like this, it would surely turn into hatred, so it would be better to leave for the moment.

units.source_text: 便在储藏室外恳切要求：“即使略开一条门缝也好！”

en.t: So from outside the storeroom he pleaded earnestly, "Even opening the door just a crack would be enough!"

units.source_text: 然而里面绝无回音。

en.t: But from inside there was absolutely no reply.

units.source_text: 夕雾吟诗云：

en.t: Yugiri then recited a poem, saying:
